alex: Quick kickoff for 1.14.1 RN + internal announce. Target cut: tomorrow 21:30 PT. Need two things: a one-line internal blast for CS/sales and a slightly longer ops note with exact rollback triggers. Who can draft each?
neha: I can take the CS/sales line. Keep it consumer-friendly.
dom: I'll do ops note and pin choreography. Planning an incremental ramp: 5% for 10m, 25% for 20m, 100% if green.
alex: thanks. Priya can you own docs snippets + console copy?
priya: yep. I'll update the model-pinning help text and add the new screenshot. ETA 3h.
deploybot: Scheduled deploy: release/1.14.1 -> prod at 2025-11-17T21:30:00Z. Strategy: canary 5% (10m) -> 25% (20m) -> 100% (manual). Auto-rollback disabled; manual rollback allowed via `deploybot rollback <release>` command.
dom: Ops preferred rollback criteria: any sustained increase of request_5xx_rate by 15% vs baseline for 8 minutes OR p99 latency +300ms for 5 minutes. Also roll forward to fallback tag `release/1.13.5-hotfix` if capacity anomalies detected.
neha: Drafted internal one-liner for CS: "Shipping 1.14.1 tomorrow 21:30 PT — backend batching improvements and UI copy polish. No schema changes; outage unlikely." Any objections?
alex: add 'expect brief at T-30m' to set expectations.
priya: Docs bullets for RN: `- perf: adaptive small-prompt batching (saves up to ~20% on small requests)
- infra: fix race in dispatcher shutdown
- docs: clarify pin/unpin flow in console`
dom: Ops note (short): `Pin: dom (ops). Monitor: canary-5m-metrics, p99_latency_panel, 5xx_rate_alerts. Rollback process: manual rollback via deploybot; page oncall and tag release lead.`
pager-bot: Reminder: oncall window for cut: primary=neil, secondary=marco. Escalation via PagerDuty.
neha: I'll post CS line at T-30m. Alex — can you send the engineering internal note to eng@redwood at T-15m?
alex: yes. Final checklist: deploybot schedule set, ops note posted in runbook, docs updated by Priya, CS/Sales one-liner owned by Neha. Leaving manual rollback enabled for tighter control. Good luck :rocket:
dom: locking this thread. I'll attach the abbreviated runbook to the deploybot ticket and seed the dashboard links.
